purpose: piano kernel pin for the RAM bring-up variants and the installed first-release Ubuntu system (persistent boot images, full module tree); hardware status is in docs/STATUS.md, not implied by this pin
note: The kernel repository is private (owner yzddmr6) until publication; cloning needs access. 'config' is the base fragment read by tools/build-kernel.sh; the installed release merges the remaining release_config_fragments in that order via CONFIG_FRAGMENT_EXTRA (space separated). piano-release.config is last and sets the unique release 7.2.6-piano<ABI>; kernel/abi.json records which commit and .config each packaged release was built from.
